staleness.//: Thresholds are BUSINESS days. The OIR file is produced on weekdays only, so a demand can never last-change on a weekend. With calendar days the 4-5 day L2 window lands entirely on Sat+Sun every Thursday, making that tier unreachable and jumping L1 straight to L3. Set use_business_days=false to revert.

notification.//: max_items_per_digest caps the demands listed individually in one message; the rest are summarised as a count so nothing is silently dropped. Escalation recipients are resolved per tier: 'adh' is the Account Delivery Head, a single configured address (ACCOUNT_DELIVERY_HEAD_EMAIL) rather than a column in the OIR file - SL_DM_NAME is the same person as TM_NAME on 206/209 rows, so escalating to it is a no-op.
